CARGO_KILLED_SCRIPT_MUTATIONS: a piece of one character stays out of the workspace-wide pool and is judged only in a file's reach; pooled, one unrelated character completes a path and refuses every file of a lone-character tree (SPEC-331 R1)

a file's reach holds the pieces of every file it includes, transitively; without the include step, a character held in an included file no longer joins its includer's pieces and that spelling goes unrefused (SPEC-331 R2)
a file's reach holds the pieces of every const or static item it names; without them, a character held by a named const in another file no longer joins and that spelling goes unrefused (SPEC-331 R2)

the name is covered when one file's reach covers it; with the reaches discarded, only the pool of two or more characters judges and every spelling joined through a one-character piece goes unrefused (SPEC-331 R3)
a format string's placeholder name is a name its file writes; unrecorded, a one-character const captured inline by a format string from another file no longer reaches its join (SPEC-331 R2, A2)
every word a file writes is a name that can name an item; recorded as nothing, a one-character const named from another file no longer reaches the file that names it (SPEC-331 R2)

a const or static item named by a macro's metavariable has a name the reader cannot read, so its one-character pieces stay in the workspace-wide pool, failing closed; held back, a macro-defined one-character const joins nothing (SPEC-331 R2, A2)
